title: Sold for $650,000. Why only $200,000 in cash?

lines.say: You sell your flat for 650,000 dollars. The cash that reaches you could be about 200,000.
First, your outstanding loan is paid off. Say 200,000.
Next, every CPF dollar you used goes back to your CPF, with interest. Say 250,000.
What's left is your cash: 200,000, before agent and legal fees.
That's the number your next downpayment is built on.
So work out your cash proceeds before you commit to your next home.
Save this before you list your flat.

source: Illustration. Check your figures with your bank and CPF.
caption:
Selling your flat for $650,000? The cash that reaches you could be about $200,000. 🏠

First, your outstanding loan is paid off. Say $200,000. Next, every CPF dollar you used goes back to your CPF, with interest. Say $250,000. What's left is your cash: $200,000, before agent and legal fees.

That's the number your next downpayment is built on. Work out your cash proceeds before you commit to your next home.

Save this before you list your flat 👇
